## Code Reviews

- When reviewing a pull request read the body of the pull request and identify the "Type of Work" and the "Topic".
- Select the skill to be used for the review from the table below with the row that matches the "Type of Work" and the "Topic".
- Use only the indicated skill and review only the criteria explicitly mentioned in the skill.
- Place your findings in a table in the final review comment on the pull request rather than on comments on individual lines of code.
- Always mark your review as "Comment" rather than "Approve" or "Request Changes".

| Type of Work | Topic        | Skill                 |
| ------------ | ------------ | --------------------- |
| Tutorial     | HTML and CSS | tutorial-01-html-css  |
| Extension    | HTML and CSS | extension-01-html-css |
